changes: A jack in ACTION mode with ACTION set to OFF is no longer read in every audio block, which leaves the Rytm more CPU for playing, so pads respond a little faster. Its bars still show the level.
With no jack in ACTION mode the mod's audio work is now a two-byte check.
The input is now read 1,500 times a second and acts at once; before, an action could come up to about 80 ms late, enough to start REC HLD or REC TGL's sequencer late.
A footswitch's bounce is ignored for 10 ms after each press or release.
The bars' right-hand line now moves with the actions.
Changing the levels or REVERSE DIRECTION no longer plays the action by itself.
First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: a new ACTION mode in GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2.
A footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate holds or toggles the MUTE screen or live recording, or holds or latches FILL.
Bars beside the menu show the input and when it counts as pressed; ACTION LEARN reads a footswitch's levels.
NO in EXPRESSION LEARN and ACTION LEARN now keeps the levels you had.
